an8.36:1.3: Dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ. 3.
an8.36:2.1: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ parittaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ parittaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:2.2: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā manussasobhaggaṃ upapajjati. 4.
an8.36:3.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ mattaso kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ mattaso kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:3.2: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā manussasobhaggaṃ upapajjati. 5.
an8.36:4.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:4.2: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:4.3: Tatra bhikkhave cattāro mahārājāno dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā Cātummahārājike deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhanti:
an8.36:4.4: dibbena āyunā, dibbena vaṇṇena, dibbena sukhena, dibbena yasena, dibbena ādhipateyyena, dibbehi rūpehi, dibbehi saddehi, dibbehi gandhehi, dibbehi rasehi, dibbehi phoṭṭhabbehi. 6.
an8.36:5.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:5.2: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:5.3: Tatra bhikkhave Sakko devānam indo dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā Tāvatiṃse deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an8.36:6.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:6.2: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Yāmānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:6.3: Tatra bhikkhave Suyāmo devaputto dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā Yāme deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an8.36:7.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:7.2: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Tusitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:7.3: Tatra bhikkhave Santusito devaputto dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā Tusite deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an8.36:8.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:8.2: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Nimmānaratīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:8.3: Tatra bhikkhave Sunimmito devaputto dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā Nimmānaratī deva dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an8.36:9.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ adhimattaṃ kataṃ hoti, bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti.
an8.36:9.2: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Paranimmitanvasavattīnaṃ Devānaṃ sahavyataṃ upapajjati.
an8.36:9.3: Tatra bhikkhave Vasavattī devaputto dānamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā sīlamayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ atirekaṃ karitvā Paranimmitavasavattī deve dasahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an8.36:9.4: dibbena āyunā, dibbena vaṇṇena, dibbena sukhena, dibbena yasena, dibbena ādhipateyyena, dibbehi rūpehi, dibbehi saddehi, dibbehi gandhehi, dibbehi rasehi, dibbehi phoṭṭhabbehi.
an8.36:9.5: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi puññakiriyavatthūnī ti. 1.
